audit_phase: Phase 3.1 — Benchmark Validity and End-to-End Security Evaluation

permission_derivation_setup.zero_trust_principle: Least-privilege permissions derived strictly from clean task ground truth, never trusting injection content.
permission_derivation_setup.derivation_code: clean_env = suite.load_and_inject_default_environment({}); task_env = ut.init_environment(clean_env); allowed_tools = list(dict.fromkeys([c.function for c in ut.ground_truth(task_env)]))

comparisons.notes: Unprotected pipeline: all tool requests reach environment without check.

comparisons.defense: DPVG Stage A (Cryptographic Scope) + Stage B (Semantic Alignment)
comparisons.notes: Legitimate tool calls permitted; scope bounds enforce least privilege; zero side effects on rejected calls.

comparisons.defense: DPVG Full Gateway (Stage A + Stage B + Scope Enforcement + Token Optimization)
comparisons.notes: Token optimization applied to intent; identical security guarantees and tool authorization ledger.
